title: Interstellar
description: 《星际穿越》主题曲的长笛与钢琴改编（Ariana & Ella Piknjač 版）。 misterioso 的长旋律线在绵密的钢琴织体上铺展，广袤而深情，如星空般辽远——适合练习长乐句的气息控制与情绪递进。
descriptionEn: The theme from Interstellar, arranged for flute and piano (Ariana & Ella Piknjač version). A misterioso long melodic line unfolds over a dense piano texture — vast and heartfelt, distant as the stars. Fine practice for breath control across long phrases and for building emotional shape.
